source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Integrity Committee Leader (December 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be an appointment of a new WCA Integrity Committee (WIC) Leader, as Shain Longbehn’s term is ending. We would like to thank Shain for the work he has done leading the Integrity Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Integrity Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Experience in conducting and overseeing investigations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Commitment to confidentiality and ethical conduct
  • Good judgment and decision-making skills
  • Familiarity with WCA activities
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until December 31, 2025, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WIC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WIC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2025.3.

After the application period, the WCA Board will interview the most qualified applicants, make a selection by voting, and announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of WCA Motion 10.2025.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support,

translation.title: 招募 WCA 诚信委员会负责人（2025 年 12 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

Shain Longbehn 的任期即将结束，将任命新的 WCA 诚信委员会（WIC）负责人。感谢 Shain 领导委员会所做的工作。

候选人应履行 24 个月任期，平均每周投入至少 8 小时。期望素质包括：强领导力；开展和监督调查的经验；出色的分析与解决问题能力；保密和遵守伦理的承诺；良好的判断及决策能力；熟悉 WCA 活动；出色沟通能力。

申请期为即日起至 **2025 年 12 月 31 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下发送至执行助理团队 [assistants@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:assistants@worldcubeassociation.org)，并抄送理事会 [board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)。

申请文件必须为 PDF，包含：
1. 简短自我介绍；
2. 为 WCA 所做活动概述；
3. 担任 WIC 负责人的目标。

另请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请副本。

WIC 权利与职责见[动议 10.2025.3](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.3%20-%20Integrity%20Committee.pdf)。申请期结束后，理事会将面试最符合条件的申请人，投票遴选并宣布新负责人，流程见[动议 10.2025.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节。

感谢申请与支持。
